problems: e16: hinge ↔ clip is not a compatible pair
notes: The minifigure (hard hat, head, torso, legs) is not in the parts list, so it is not modelled.
The booklet gives only pictures, so many stud positions are uncertain. I used null ports wherever the exact studs could not be read.

The build order of pieces within steps is inferred: step 4 (3 grille tiles + 2 trans-red plates), step 5 (rear clip plate), step 6 (seat + front clip plate), step 7 (curved brick, steering stand, bar 1x4x2, hinge arm), step 8 (flipped: two 2x2 bricks, 2x2 plate, wheel holders), step 9 (wheels and tyres), step 10 (bucket), step 11 (tools, cone, minifig).
The underside layering is assumed: the plate 2x6 carries the 2x2 bricks, and the wheel holders sit on the bricks.
The arm is assumed to join the front clip through the hinge plate's finger, and the bucket to the hinge brick's hinge.
The shovel and jackhammer positions at the rear are ambiguous. I put both in the rear clip plate b9.
The cone is assumed to sit on the bar 1x4x2 studs.
